svg.title: Convolutional Neural Network, six-stage classification example
svg.desc: Input image, convolutional filters making feature maps, ReLU, max pooling, flatten and fully connected layers, classification output. An educational reconstruction following the Dragon1 CNN explanation. Example results are illustrative, not computed predictions.
svg.text: A CNN LEARNS VISUAL FEATURES IN STAGES
Typical image classification architecture · repeated Conv / ReLU / Pooling blocks
Learned filters extract and combine features; example outputs are not measured predictions.
